CLASSIFICATION::urlcat
       Deprecated: provides classification url category name.

SYNOPSIS
       CLASSIFICATION::urlcat

DESCRIPTION
       This command provides classification url category name.

       * Note: APM / AFM / PEM license is required for functionality to work.

       CLASSIFICATION::urlcat

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
       CLASSIFICATION_DETECTED

EXAMPLES
HINTS
       CLASSIFY::urlcat replaces this command

SEE ALSO
       CLASSIFY::urlcat

CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.5.0 --First introduced the command.  @BIGIP-12.0.0 -- Deprecated in favor of CLASSIFY namespace
